semantics.note: The decade-long commitment is firm. The qualification concerns an earlier arrival, not whether the shift will occur.

contract.note: A broad change in research and development emphasis is an ordinary reading. The alternative starting date does not affect this assessment: neither deadline has elapsed.

evidence.note: Dated company disclosure illustrates agent-system research but does not establish a sustained field-wide shift in relative priorities.
The review documents integration research before the forecast. It informs the baseline and cautions against reading pure focus literally, but cannot establish the predicted subsequent shift.

reviews.rationale: The deadline remains ahead. Neither the company disclosure nor the review supplies convergent longitudinal evidence meeting the early-resolution rule. Existing integration research does not by itself settle a forecast about changing field-wide emphasis.

reviews.rationale: No deadline is stated, and neither evaluation meets the early-resolution rule. Aggregate accuracy and consistency across repeated inputs cannot establish or refute difficulty anticipating individual outcomes across representative requests.
